name: Shimmering Souls
source:
Always wondered what the afterlife was like? Welp, you're dead and you still don't know. A bug in the system, you're now working with purgatory guard Az to... harvest souls? Or save them?? I don't know, man. This is confusing.

In this short but heavy visual novel, meet our numerous named and unnamed characters ready to step into death's embrace. Laugh and dance your heart away. Be sickeningly cruel. Cosplay a wolf. Have fun; you never know when you must part ways with this beautiful world.

[From [url=https://cinnamew.itch.io/shimmering-souls]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
总是想知道来世是什么样的？好吧，你已经死了，但你仍然不知道。系统bug，你现在和炼狱守卫阿兹合作……收割灵魂？还是拯救他们？？我不知道，伙计。这很令人困惑。

在这部简短而沉重的视觉小说中，我们将见到众多有名和无名的角色，他们正准备步入死亡的怀抱。欢笑、跳舞，让你的心都流淌。残忍得令人作呕。角色扮演一只狼。玩得开心;你永远不知道什么时候你必须与这个美丽的世界分开。

[来自[url=https://cinnamew.itch.io/shimmering-souls]itch.io[/url]]
